name: Follow movement: uncontrolled guardian keeps its own spline speed
contract: Upstream #27719 distinguishes guardians without pet bars from controllable guardians. Authentic SummonProperties 1021 creates the Mirror Image guardian without the controllable flag; assertions verify that classification. With its own native run speed 7 yd/s and owner fixture run speed 14 yd/s, a recall from 40 yd must launch an active native follow spline at 7 yd/s. Before the fix it inherits and boosts owner speed. Fixture SetSpeed replaces actual mounting and MotionMaster::MoveFollow replaces a pet-bar request; this tests native movement execution, not summon-spell acquisition, client animation, mounted speed effects or completed travel.
